messages:
zoe: quick sync  finalizing internal release note for v9.1.0. need concise blurb, pinned artifact for Dedicated, and a deploy-bot dry-run so accounts + oncall can copy the exact phrasing.
ryan: blurb suggestion: 'v9.1.0: smarter batching + cache hotspots to reduce tail latency. No API changes; backward compatible.' two lines.
meera: please include the exact pin for Dedicated customers. i'll add to the account outreach.
accounts-team: pinned artifact -> model-edge@v9.1.0 (sha: aa11bb2). we'll include \"Pinned for Dedicated\" note in the accounts copy.
zoe: add rollback guard: auto-rollback to v9.0.8 if 3m error rate > 0.85% OR p95 latency increases > 35% for 3m. keep it conservative.
oncall: prefer an alert softening instead of muting for the first 6m. suggest raising thresholds in alerts policy.
ryan: added an initial_adjust block to the deploy config. will paste snippet for docs appendix.
meera: @deploy-bot can you run a staging dry-run for thread 9934567890 so docs can copy verbatim? tag the output [STAGING-DRY].
deploy-bot: acknowledged. running staging dry-run for thread 9934567890. emitting messages flagged [STAGING-DRY]. ETA ~90s.
deploy-bot: dry-run output:
- \"[STAGING-DRY] Release v9.1.0 scheduled. Canary: us-west 20m -> ramp to 50% over 15m. Pin: model-edge@v9.1.0 (aa11bb2) \u2014 Pinned for Dedicated\"
- \"Rollback: 3m error rate > 0.85% OR p95 latency +35% -> rollback to v9.0.8\"
- \"Initial alert adjustment: error_rate threshold -> 1.2% for first 6m; p95 delta -> +55% for first 6m\"
- \"Owners: zoe (release), meera (accounts/docs), ryan (deploy), oncall (pager)\"
ryan: snippet for appendix (minimal): 
```
canary: { region: \"us-west\", duration: \"20m\" }
ramp: { to: \"50%\", duration: \"15m\" }
pin: \"model-edge@v9.1.0 (aa11bb2) - Pinned for Dedicated\"
alerts: { initial_adjust: { error_rate: \"1.2%\", p95_delta: \"+55%\", window: \"6m\" } }
rollback: { window: \"3m\", error_rate: \"0.85%\", p95_delta: \"+35%\", fallback: \"v9.0.8\" }
blackout: { region: \"eu\", start: \"23:30Z\", end: \"02:30Z\" }
```
meera: perfect. i'll paste that into the release notes doc and the account heads-up. also DM'ing VIP reps now.
zoe: who will post the internal blast? want it T-8 before canary so people can pin and reviewers can react.
ryan: i can post and pin. scheduling for 2025-03-22T10:22:00Z (T-8). will tag owners and the accounts-team.
oncall: after ryan posts i'll validate pager thresholds and blackout windows. will also run the preflight checklist at canary start.
zoe: small copy tweak: change '\\"smarter batching + cache hotspots\\"' -> '\\"smarter batching and hotspot cache tuning\\"'. clearer for docs.
ryan: updated. final blurb: 'v9.1.0: smarter batching and hotspot cache tuning to reduce tail latency. No API changes; backward compatible.'
meera: all good from accounts side. closing this thread after the dry-run copy is copied into the release notes doc. :thumbsup:
